consume_points.usage: 5B-record DECODER (direct buffer): reads wire [03][01][val_hi][val_lo][idx] byte-wise and rebuilds in-memory struct {u16 0x0301 @0, u16 value @2 (LE), u8 playerIdx @4}; playerIdx validated <=0xa (cmp #0xa); follow-on 6-byte records (u32+u16 BE) looped idx times (stride 6). The u16 value (per-player lane position) is assembled from ldrb [x1,#3]+[x1,#2] into dst[2..3].
5B-record DECODER (ring-buffer variant of 0x2a35f38): reads wire bytes 1,0,3,2,4 -> dst {u16 0x0301, u16 value, u8 idx}; cmp #0xa player-index bound (0x2a36114).

Second copy of the 5B-record DECODER (same wire->memory mapping: [03][01][u16 BE][u8 idx], bytes 1,0,3,2,4 -> dst 0..4). No idx bound check in this copy (bound check lives in the 0x2a35f38/0x2a36078 variants). Codec family has multiple instances (direct + ring + duplicated).

5B-record ENCODER (direct): mirror of 0x2a35f38. Reads memory u16s (ldrh [x0] = tag 0x0301, ldrh [x0,#2] = value) and u8 idx ([x0,#4], cmp #0xa) and emits wire [03][01][value_hi][value_lo][idx] (BE byte pair). Confirms in-memory record struct = {u16 0x0301, u16 value, u8 idx} and wire BE encoding.
5B-record ENCODER (ring-buffer variant of 0x2a35c3c): same u16 reads (ldrh [x0], [x0,#2]) + idx (ldrb [x0,#4], cmp #0xa) into a ring buffer [x1].

u16 CONSUME (position integration): iterates per-player list ([x22] = begin/end of 8-byte pointers), reads u16 at player+0xa (per-player lane position, already decoded), stores it at [sp] as the Fix32 input, then tail-calls the Fix32 integrator (0x461f274 -> 0x461f44c). Direct integer path, no float constants.

Fix32 position integrator (mid-entry -> 0x461f44c prologue): pos = base([x20+0x38]) + Fix32(u16) * speed([x20+0x28]); Fix32(u16) = (u16 & 0x3FFFF) << 14 | 0x2000 (i.e. u16*16384 + rounding); >>14 after multiply. Second axis from [sp+4] x [x20+0x48]. PURE INTEGER math — matches 'no float position constants, conversion must be integer/Fix32'. u16 1 LSB = 1/16384 Fix32 = 0.22888 map units when speed Fix32 = 15000 (0x3A98, 15000/65536=0.22888).

Related codec (different variant): count-byte header (cmp #0x32 = 50-byte entry limit) + reversed byte-wise copy of 6-byte records (stride 6). Same family as 0x2a35xxx codecs but layout has no 0x0301 tag; likely serves the 0x32-byte frame-entry message (cf. 0x1a5d3f4).

Frame encoder (different message): iterates 0x32-byte frame entries ([x22] list), reads u16 at entry+0 (ldrh [x22]) + u32, byte-swaps (rev) and appends BE [u32][u16] to wire buffer. Not the 5B-record path but shares BE-u16 wire encoding and 0x32 entry size.

constants.usage: u16->position is integer Fix32 only: (u16<<14 | 0x2000) * speedFix32 >> 14 at 0x461f274; 1 LSB = 1/16384 Fix32 = 0.22888 units when speedFix32 = 15000

notes: Consume chain: wire [u32 type7][u32 seq][02][00][subtype][focus][] -> 5B-record DECODER 0x2a35f38 (byte-wise, no marker compares; idx bound cmp #0xa) -> in-memory record {u16 0x0301, u16 value, u8 idx} -> player entry (u16 at +0xa) -> Fix32 integrator 0x461f210/0x461f274 (integer: bfi #0xe + mul + asr #14). The 0x42e island (0x42e7190-0x42eb190) and the 0x1a57 island (0x1a57000-0x1a5b190) contain NO payload byte reads: 0x42e ldrh sites (0x42e85d8/0x42e87b4/0x42eb844/0x42ebf20) are singleton-registry ID lookups (ldrh [x12,#2]+cmp); 0x1a57 island (4096 insns) has only ldrb [x26,#0x78] (log flag) + ldr [x,#0x10/0x18/0x20]. sync-apply chain (0x42e9874/0x42e91c4/0x42ea488/0x42ea550/0x42ea6a0) consumes already-decoded values. Global evidence: exactly 1 rev16 in whole .text (0x1a5fb78, message-flags switch 0x700/0x800 — unrelated); lsl#8 sites are a compressor (0x429b204+), div-255 helper (0x483415c), LUT accessor (0x4cdee78), clz-log2 encoder (0x5367694) — none decode the record u16 (it is decoded byte-wise, consistent with positional parse + previous negative evidence). The 0x2a35xxx codec family is reached only via runtime-built method pointers (no static bl sites, no 8-byte data refs, no adrp refs) [INFERENCE]. 0x1a56c60's bl #0x42e9bf4 passes garbage x9/w25 -> decoy/log-fragment path (dead at runtime [INFERENCE]); real payload path is 0x1aa1028 buffer copy.
